title: Judge verdict
description: What the judge returns for one run: one entry per rubric block, each with the exact quotes that decided it, and one overall result.

overall_reason.description: One paragraph in plain sentences. For a fail, the first block that failed and the line that failed it. For pass with findings, the one sentence or session that fell short.

judged_on.description: The transcript or evidence files the verdict rests on, by name.

quotes.description: Exact text from a transcript or an exact field from evidence/. Never a paraphrase. Empty only for not exercised.

reason.description: One or two sentences. For unclear, what would settle it.
